recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色低倍率下，大量細胞呈強烈細胞膜陽性，以間質性到大片狀分布於脂肪空泡之間，殘存造血細胞為陰性；最可能是 CD20 等 B 細胞標記，顯示毛細胞白血病變異型的廣泛骨髓侵犯。
features: Bone marrow core at low power with diffuse interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate
Strong, crisp membranous brown staining of numerous small to intermediate cells
Positive cells separated by clear membrane outlines giving a honeycomb pattern
Interspersed negative residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces
No nodular or paratrabecular aggregates evident in this field
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow biopsy shows an extensive interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of small to intermediate cells with strong membranous positivity, arranged between fat spaces and residual negative hematopoietic elements. The positive cells are well spaced with crisp membranous outlines, and there is no distinct nodular or paratrabecular pattern in this field. The antibody is not labeled; the pattern is most consistent with a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20. Findings indicate extensive marrow involvement by a B-cell neoplasm, consistent with hairy cell leukemia variant in context; annexin A1, CD25 and BRAF V600E studies separate it from classic HCL.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL has the same interstitial CD20+ pattern but is annexin A1+, CD25+, cyclin D1 weak+ and BRAF V600E+, which HCL-v lacks.
SMZL usually forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates rather than a diffuse interstitial pattern.
CLL cells coexpress CD5 and CD23/LEF1 and often form nodules with proliferation centers.

stain: IHC: B-cell marker, presumed CD20 (not labeled)
